crossRefs.note: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.
Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with…
The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts; but they don’t respect the work of Yahweh…
and behold, joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink…
Who lie on beds of ivory, and stretch themselves on their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves…

translations.web: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
translations.bsb: singing to the tambourine and lyre and making merry at the sound of the flute.
translations.kjv: They take the timbrel and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the organ.
translations.asv: They sing to the timbrel and harp, And rejoice at the sound of the pipe.
